notes.title: 🔴 Indie Live Expo 2021 - Affectus: Dev Commentary
notes.content:
Event Information
We're part of the Indie Live Expo Winter 2021 Event from November 6 - November 12!

About Affectus
A cyberpunk stealth-action RPG set in a decadent and sick megalopolis, where the only way to feel good is a drug called Affectus. With no memory, you must unravel the mysteries of your past. Acquire implants, infiltrate, hack, or fight to uncover a vast conspiracy and find a cure to the virus.

Dev insights & gameplay
Valentin (Affectus Games) will talk about the inspiration and ideas behind Affectus.
A lot of behind the scenes content is waiting for you.
Watch the broadcast on the store page https://store.steampowered.com/app/1478710/Affectus/

notes.title: 🔴 AG French Direct 2021 - Affectus: Dev Commentary
notes.content:
Nous faisons partie de l'événement AG French Direct 2021 le 3 novembre 2021 !

À propos d'affectus
Un RPG d'action furtif cyberpunk se déroulant dans une mégalopole décadente et malade, où la seule façon de se sentir bien est une drogue appelée Affectus. Amnésique, vous devez percer les mystères de votre passé. Obtenez des implants, infiltrez-vous, piratez ou combattez pour découvrir une vaste conspiration et trouver un remède au virus.

Informations de développement et gameplay
Valentin (Affectus Games) parlera de l'inspiration et des idées derrière Affectus.
Beaucoup de contenu en coulisses vous attend.
Regardez l'émission sur la page steam !

notes.title: Patch Notes V0.26.0
notes.content:
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] FIXED: Weapons can now be equipped inside rooms. It may happen that you can't equip it when leaving the room. It will be fixed in the next release.
[*] FIXED: focus or cursor lost during dialogs.
[*] FIXED: Corrupted save that made you lose your progression and restart the game with a glitch after the pharmacy mission.
[*] FIXED: Player jump after finishing a dialog.
[*] FIXED: Player crawling animation playing while crouching (controller)
[/list]

[h2]General improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Music: The music is now persistent between scenes. No more cut when loading a level.
[*] UI: Added Weapon equip/holster indications in the HUD  
[/list]

[h2]Known bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The camera is wrong for 0.5 seconds if you choose to go directly to Bones after the Pharmacist dialog.
[*] Enemies will forget about you too quickly when you hide.
[*] Some players got stuck walking in place towards the camera, trying to exit a room while not perfectly aligned with the door.
[*] Checkpoints are not saved correctly. You could spawn at the wrong place when loading a game.
[*] Some music transitions are not good
[*] Some lights are broken      
[/list]

[b]Thanks for playtesting![/b]
Don't forget to fill the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfMvRpEVVzygklfvCIlwa8oms4HF9G9j5ng1i-43_nIGijJGQ/viewform]feedback form[/url]. It helps a ton!

Did I mention that there is a Discord server you can join and give more feedback? Let's meet! https://discord.gg/46NZQUGpY8

Val@AffectusGames

notes.title: Play the Demo at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Affectus is a cyberpunk stealth-action RPG set in a decadent and sick megalopolis, where the only way to feel good is a drug called Affectus.

To mark the #NextFest, Affectus will be hosting multiple stream events throughout the week. With a variety of streamers, including me (the developer). I can't wait to show you the latest build and what the game has to offer.

[h2]What Will The Stream Involve?[/h2]

Simple - I'll be taking you through the demo from start to finish, so that you can see and hear all that the demo has to offer! [b]I'll be there to answer all your questions and maybe drop some giveaways ;)[/b]

[b]Play the demo (and Wishlist!) right here:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1478710/Affectus/

Leave me some feedback in the community hub:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1478710

See you on the 16th!

Valentin from Affectus Games

notes.title: Playtest #1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Want to try out Affectus?[/b] [/h2]
[b]Starting on May 27[/b], you'll be able to help me make the best game possible by testing the beta versions of the upcoming demo!

To sign up, it's easy: just click on the "Request Access" button directly on the Affectus Steam page. Once the playtest is open, you'll get notified by email and will be able to play. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1478710/Affectus/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39174094/df20172939cd7ea06cb303280655a5c0913e80bf.png[/img][/url]


As of today, 72 persons have already signed up and are waiting for approval. I'll approve everyone on May 27 and will be adding more people in the following weeks. If you don't get in this first playtest, there will be a few more before the game is released, so don't worry :)

[b]Please keep in mind that this is still a beta version.[/b] There is still a lot of polishing to do! Any problem or frustration that you'll face could be fixed in the final version if you tell me about it! To do so, please take 5 more minutes to fill the feedback form: 
[h3][u][b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1YvFDbE9W-U4Otu_fKbxGYOpr1g-dHBmWMYfKhs8lWCE/viewform]FEEDBACK FORM[/url][/b][/u][/h3]

[b]Your feedback is vital to make this game better, and it's also your chance to be a part of Affectus' creation. I can't wait to hear from you![/b]

Thanks for testing! Have fun, and I hope you'll like it :)

Valentin

Last thing: please add the game to your Wishlist if it's not already the case ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1478710/Affectus/
